examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب قراءة عدد متغير من الأرقام من المدخلات وحساب متوسطها.
examples.descEn: Learn to read a variable number of numbers from input and compute their average.
examples.code:
program average
  implicit none
  integer :: n, i
  real :: sum, x, avg
  ! اقرأ عدد العناصر ثم العناصر نفسها
  read(*, *) n
  sum = 0.0

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تحويل عدد عشري إلى تمثيله الثنائي باستخدام خوارزمية القسمة على 2.
examples.descEn: Learn to convert a decimal number to binary using division by 2 algorithm.
examples.code:
program decimal_to_binary
  implicit none
  integer :: n, temp, remainder
  character(len=64) :: binary
  integer :: pos

  n = 42
  temp = n
  binary = ''
  pos = 0

  if (temp == 0) then
    binary = '0'
  else
    do while (temp > 0)
      remainder = mod(temp, 2)
      write(binary(pos+1:pos+1), '(I1)') remainder
      pos = pos + 1
      temp = temp / 2
    end do
    binary = reverse(binary(1:pos))
  end if

  write(*, '(A,I0,A,A)') 'Binary of ', n, ' is ', trim(binary)

contains
  function reverse(str) result(rev)
    character(len=*), intent(in) :: str
    character(len=len(str)) :: rev
    integer :: i, n
    n = len(str)
    do i = 1, n
      rev(i:i) = str(n-i+1:n-i+1)
    end do
  end function reverse
end program decimal_to_binary

examples.titleEn: Binary Search in a Sorted Array
examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب خوارزمية البحث الثنائي الفعالة على مصفوفة مرتبة مع تحديث الحدود.
examples.descEn: Learn the efficient binary search algorithm on a sorted array with boundary updates.
examples.code:
program binary_search
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: n = 7
  integer :: arr(n), low, high, mid, target, pos
  logical :: found
  arr = [2, 5, 8, 12, 16, 23, 38]
  target = 23
  low = 1
  high = n
  found = .false.
  pos = -1
  do while (low <= high)
    mid = (low + high) / 2
    if (arr(mid) == target) then
      found = .true.
      pos = mid
      exit
    else if (arr(mid) < target) then
      low = mid + 1
    else
      high = mid - 1
    end if
  end do
  if (found) then
    write(*, '(A,I0)') 'Found at index: ', pos
  else
    write(*, '(A)') 'Not found'
  end if
end program binary_search

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب بناء شجرة بحث ثنائية وإجراء اجتياز بالترتيب (inorder) لإخراج العناصر مرتبة.
examples.descEn: Build a binary search tree and perform an inorder traversal to output sorted elements.
examples.code:
program bst
  implicit none
  type :: node
    integer :: val
    type(node), pointer :: left, right
  end type
  type(node), pointer :: root
  integer :: i
  nullify(root)
  ! إدراج عناصر
  call insert(root, 50)
  call insert(root, 30)
  call insert(root, 70)
  call insert(root, 20)
  call insert(root, 40)
  ! اجتياز inorder
  call inorder(root)
contains
  recursive subroutine insert(t, x)
    type(node), pointer :: t
    integer, intent(in) :: x
    if (.not. associated(t)) then
      allocate(t)
      t%val = x
      nullify(t%left)
      nullify(t%right)
    else if (x < t%val) then
      call insert(t%left, x)
    else
      call insert(t%right, x)
    end if
  end subroutine
  recursive subroutine inorder(t)
    type(node), pointer :: t
    if (associated(t)) then
      call inorder(t%left)
      write(*, '(I0)') t%val
      call inorder(t%right)
    end if
  end subroutine
end program bst

examples.titleEn: Bubble Sort an Array of Numbers
examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب فرز مصفوفة باستخدام خوارزمية الفقاعات مع تحسين الإيقاف المبكر.
examples.descEn: Learn to sort an array using bubble sort with an early exit optimization.
examples.code:
program bubble_sort
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: n = 5
  integer :: arr(n), i, j, temp
  logical :: swapped
  arr = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22]
  do i = 1, n-1
    swapped = .false.
    do j = 1, n-i
      if (arr(j) > arr(j+1)) then
        temp = arr(j)
        arr(j) = arr(j+1)
        arr(j+1) = temp
        swapped = .true.
      end if
    end do
    if (.not. swapped) exit
  end do
  write(*, '(A,5I3)') 'Sorted: ', arr
end program bubble_sort

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب التعامل مع الأحرف وتحويلها باستخدام دالة ichar وachar لتشفير رسالة بإزاحة 3.
examples.descEn: Learn to handle characters and convert them using ichar and achar to encrypt a message with shift 3.
examples.code:
program caesar
  implicit none
  character(len=*), parameter :: msg = 'HELLO'
  character(len=len(msg)) :: encrypted
  integer :: i, code
  do i = 1, len(msg)
    code = ichar(msg(i:i))
    if (code >= ichar('A') .and. code <= ichar('Z')) then
      code = mod(code - ichar('A') + 3, 26) + ichar('A')
    end if
    encrypted(i:i) = achar(code)
  end do
  write(*, '(A)') encrypted
end program caesar

program gcd_lcm
  implicit none
  integer :: a, b, temp, x, y, gcd, lcm

  a = 12
  b = 18
  x = a
  y = b

  do while (y /= 0)
    temp = mod(x, y)
    x = y
    y = temp
  end do
  gcd = x

end program gcd_lcm

program graph_adj
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: N = 5
  integer :: adj(N, N), i, j
  ! تهيئة مصفوفة الجوار بأصفار
  adj = 0
  ! إضافة حواف (غير موجهة)
  call add_edge(1, 2)
  call add_edge(1, 3)
  call add_edge(2, 4)
  call add_edge(3, 5)
  ! طباعة الجيران لكل عقدة
  do i = 1, N
    write(*, '(A,I0,A)', advance='no') 'Node ', i, ': '
    do j = 1, N
      if (adj(i, j) == 1) then
        write(*, '(I0,1X)', advance='no') j
      end if
    end do
    write(*, *)
  end do
contains
  subroutine add_edge(u, v)
    integer, intent(in) :: u, v
    adj(u, v) = 1
    adj(v, u) = 1
  end subroutine
end program graph_adj

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب بناء جدول تجزئة بسيط مع معالجة التصادمات بالعنونة المفتوحة.
examples.descEn: Learn to build a simple hash table with open addressing for collision handling.
examples.code:
program hash_table
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: SIZE = 10
  integer :: table(SIZE), i, key, idx
  ! تهيئة الجدول بقيم -1 (فارغ)
  table = -1
  ! إدخال مفاتيح
  call insert(5)
  call insert(15)
  call insert(25)
  ! البحث عن مفتاح
  idx = search(15)
  if (idx /= -1) then
    write(*, '(A,I0)') 'Found at ', idx
  else
    write(*, '(A)') 'Not found'
  end if
contains
  subroutine insert(key)
    integer, intent(in) :: key
    integer :: h, i
    h = mod(key, SIZE) + 1
    i = h
    do while (table(i) /= -1)
      i = mod(i, SIZE) + 1
      if (i == h) then
        write(*, '(A)') 'Table full'
        return
      end if
    end do
    table(i) = key
  end subroutine
  integer function search(key)
    integer, intent(in) :: key
    integer :: h, i
    h = mod(key, SIZE) + 1
    i = h
    do while (table(i) /= -1)
      if (table(i) == key) then
        search = i
        return
      end if
      i = mod(i, SIZE) + 1
      if (i == h) exit
    end do
    search = -1
  end function
end program hash_table

examples.titleAr: دالة أعلى رتبة: تمرير دالة كوسيط
examples.titleEn: Higher-Order Function: Passing a Function as Argument
examples.descAr: يتعلّم الطالب كيفية تمرير دالة كوسيط لدالة أخرى، مما يتيح إعادة استخدام الكود بمرونة.
examples.descEn: Learn how to pass a function as an argument to another function, enabling flexible code reuse.
examples.code:
program higher_order
  implicit none
  ! لماذا تمرير دالة؟ لأنه يسمح بتخصيص السلوك دون تكرار الكود
  call apply(3, 4, add)
  call apply(3, 4, multiply)
contains
  integer function add(x, y)
    integer, intent(in) :: x, y
    add = x + y
  end function add

  integer function multiply(x, y)
    integer, intent(in) :: x, y
    multiply = x * y
  end function multiply

  subroutine apply(a, b, op)
    integer, intent(in) :: a, b
    interface
      integer function op(x, y)
        integer, intent(in) :: x, y
      end function op
    end interface
    write(*, '(A,I0)') 'result=', op(a, b)
  end subroutine apply
end program higher_order

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب خوارزمية الفرز بالإدراج وبناء المصفوفة المرتبة تدريجياً.
examples.descEn: Learn the insertion sort algorithm and building a sorted array incrementally.
examples.code:
program insertion_sort
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: n = 6
  integer :: arr(n), i, j, key
  arr = [12, 11, 13, 5, 6, 7]
  do i = 2, n
    key = arr(i)
    j = i - 1
    do while (j >= 1 .and. arr(j) > key)
      arr(j+1) = arr(j)
      j = j - 1
    end do
    arr(j+1) = key
  end do
  write(*, '(A,6I3)') 'Sorted: ', arr
end program insertion_sort

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب حل مسألة الحقيبة باستخدام جدول برمجة ديناميكية.
examples.descEn: Learn to solve the knapsack problem using a dynamic programming table.
examples.code:
program knapsack
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: n = 4, cap = 5
  integer :: weights(n), values(n), dp(0:n, 0:cap)
  integer :: i, w
  weights = [2, 3, 4, 5]
  values = [3, 4, 5, 6]
  dp = 0
  do i = 1, n
    do w = 1, cap
      if (weights(i) <= w) then
        dp(i, w) = max(dp(i-1, w), values(i) + dp(i-1, w-weights(i)))
      else
        dp(i, w) = dp(i-1, w)
      end if
    end do
  end do
  write(*, '(A,I0)') 'Max value: ', dp(n, cap)
end program knapsack

examples.descEn: Learn to compute mean, median, and standard deviation for a dataset.
examples.code:
program statistics
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: n = 5
  real :: data(n)
  real :: mean, variance, stddev, median
  integer :: i

  data = [4.0, 2.0, 5.0, 1.0, 3.0]

  mean = sum(data) / n

  variance = sum((data - mean)**2) / n
  stddev = sqrt(variance)

  call sort(data, n)
  if (mod(n, 2) == 0) then
    median = (data(n/2) + data(n/2+1)) / 2.0
  else
    median = data((n+1)/2)
  end if

  write(*, '(A,F6.2)') 'Mean: ', mean
  write(*, '(A,F6.2)') 'Median: ', median
  write(*, '(A,F6.2)') 'StdDev: ', stddev

contains
  subroutine sort(arr, m)
    integer, intent(in) :: m
    real, intent(inout) :: arr(m)
    integer :: i, j
    real :: temp
    do i = 1, m-1
      do j = i+1, m
        if (arr(i) > arr(j)) then
          temp = arr(i)
          arr(i) = arr(j)
          arr(j) = temp
        end if
      end do
    end do
  end subroutine sort
end program statistics

examples.descAr: يتعلّم الطالب استخدام مصفوفة تخزين مؤقت لتسريع حساب متتالية فيبوناتشي، متجنباً الحساب المتكرر.
examples.descEn: Learn to use a cache array to speed up Fibonacci calculation, avoiding repeated computation.
examples.code:
program memoize_fib
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: n = 10
  integer :: i
  integer, dimension(0:n) :: cache = -1
  ! لماذا التخزين المؤقت؟ لأن كل قيمة تُحسب مرة واحدة فقط، فيصبح التعقيد خطياً
  do i = 0, n
    write(*, '(A,I0,A,I0)') 'fib(', i, ')=', fib(i)
  end do
contains
  recursive integer function fib(k) result(res)
    integer, intent(in) :: k
    if (cache(k) /= -1) then
      res = cache(k)
      return
    end if
    if (k <= 1) then
      res = k
    else
      res = fib(k-1) + fib(k-2)
    end if
    cache(k) = res
  end function fib
end program memoize_fib

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب خوارزمية الفرز بالدمج القائمة على التقسيم والدمج.
examples.descEn: Learn the merge sort algorithm based on divide and merge.
examples.code:
program merge_sort
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: n = 7
  integer :: arr(n)
  arr = [38, 27, 43, 3, 9, 82, 10]
  call mergesort(arr, 1, n)
  write(*, '(A,7I3)') 'Sorted: ', arr
contains
  recursive subroutine mergesort(a, low, high)
    integer, intent(inout) :: a(*)
    integer, intent(in) :: low, high
    integer :: mid
    if (low < high) then
      mid = (low + high) / 2
      call mergesort(a, low, mid)
      call mergesort(a, mid+1, high)
      call merge(a, low, mid, high)
    end if
  end subroutine mergesort
  subroutine merge(a, low, mid, high)
    integer, intent(inout) :: a(*)
    integer, intent(in) :: low, mid, high
    integer :: temp(high-low+1), i, j, k
    i = low
    j = mid+1
    k = 1
    do while (i <= mid .and. j <= high)
      if (a(i) <= a(j)) then
        temp(k) = a(i)
        i = i + 1
      else
        temp(k) = a(j)
        j = j + 1
      end if
      k = k + 1
    end do
    do while (i <= mid)
      temp(k) = a(i)
      i = i + 1
      k = k + 1
    end do
    do while (j <= high)
      temp(k) = a(j)
      j = j + 1
      k = k + 1
    end do
    do i = 1, high-low+1
      a(low+i-1) = temp(i)
    end do
  end subroutine merge
end program merge_sort

program prime_factorization
  implicit none
  integer :: n, i

  n = 84
  write(*, '(A,I0,A)', advance='no') 'Factors of ', n, ': '

  i = 2
  do while (i * i <= n)
    do while (mod(n, i) == 0)
      write(*, '(I0,1X)', advance='no') i
      n = n / i
    end do
    i = i + 1
  end do

end program prime_factorization

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تنفيذ طابور دائري (FIFO) بمصفوفة ثابتة مع مؤشرين أمام وخلف.
examples.descEn: Implement a circular queue (FIFO) with a fixed array using front and rear pointers.
examples.code:
program circular_queue
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: MAX = 5
  integer :: q(MAX), front, rear, i
  front = 1
  rear = 1
  ! إدخال عناصر
  call enqueue(1)
  call enqueue(2)
  call enqueue(3)
  ! إخراج عنصرين
  write(*, '(I0)') dequeue()
  write(*, '(I0)') dequeue()
  ! إدخال عنصرين آخرين
  call enqueue(4)
  call enqueue(5)
  ! إخراج الباقي
  do i = 1, 3
    write(*, '(I0)') dequeue()
  end do
contains
  subroutine enqueue(x)
    integer, intent(in) :: x
    if ((rear + 1 - front + MAX) == MAX) then
      write(*, '(A)') 'Queue full'
    else
      q(rear) = x
      rear = mod(rear, MAX) + 1
    end if
  end subroutine
  integer function dequeue()
    if (front == rear) then
      dequeue = -999
    else
      dequeue = q(front)
      front = mod(front, MAX) + 1
    end if
  end function
end program circular_queue

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب خوارزمية الفرز السريع مع دالة تقسيم واختيار المحور.
examples.descEn: Learn the quick sort algorithm with a partition function and pivot selection.
examples.code:
program quick_sort
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: n = 8
  integer :: arr(n)
  arr = [10, 7, 8, 9, 1, 5, 3, 2]
  call quicksort(arr, 1, n)
  write(*, '(A,8I3)') 'Sorted: ', arr
contains
  recursive subroutine quicksort(a, low, high)
    integer, intent(inout) :: a(*)
    integer, intent(in) :: low, high
    integer :: pivot_index
    if (low < high) then
      pivot_index = partition(a, low, high)
      call quicksort(a, low, pivot_index-1)
      call quicksort(a, pivot_index+1, high)
    end if
  end subroutine quicksort
  integer function partition(a, low, high)
    integer, intent(inout) :: a(*)
    integer, intent(in) :: low, high
    integer :: pivot, i, j, temp
    pivot = a(high)
    i = low - 1
    do j = low, high-1
      if (a(j) <= pivot) then
        i = i + 1
        temp = a(i)
        a(i) = a(j)
        a(j) = temp
      end if
    end do
    temp = a(i+1)
    a(i+1) = a(high)
    a(high) = temp
    partition = i + 1
  end function partition
end program quick_sort

examples.descEn: Learn to build a singly linked list using pointers, add elements, and print them.
examples.code:
program linked_list
  implicit none
  type :: node
    integer :: val
    type(node), pointer :: next
  end type
  type(node), pointer :: head, tail, curr
  integer :: i
  ! تهيئة القائمة فارغة
  nullify(head)
  ! إضافة عناصر 1..5
  do i = 1, 5
    allocate(tail)
    tail%val = i
    nullify(tail%next)
    if (.not. associated(head)) then
      head => tail
    else
      curr => head
      do while (associated(curr%next))
        curr => curr%next
      end do
      curr%next => tail
    end if
  end do
  ! طباعة القائمة
  curr => head
  do while (associated(curr))
    write(*, '(I0)') curr%val
    curr => curr%next
  end do
end program linked_list

examples.titleEn: Split a String into Parts and Join Them
examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام دالة index لتقسيم نص بفاصل ودمج الأجزاء بفاصل آخر.
examples.descEn: Learn to use the index function to split a string by a delimiter and join parts with another delimiter.
examples.code:
program split_join
  implicit none
  character(len=50) :: s = 'a,b,c'
  character(len=10) :: parts(3)
  character(len=50) :: result
  integer :: i, pos, start, nparts
  start = 1
  nparts = 0
  do
    pos = index(s(start:), ',')
    if (pos == 0) then
      nparts = nparts + 1
      parts(nparts) = s(start:)
      exit
    else
      nparts = nparts + 1
      parts(nparts) = s(start:start+pos-2)
      start = start + pos
    end if
  end do
  result = ''
  do i = 1, nparts
    result = trim(result) // trim(parts(i))
    if (i < nparts) result = trim(result) // ';'
  end do
  write(*, '(A)') trim(result)
end program split_join

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تنفيذ مكدّس (LIFO) باستخدام مصفوفة ثابتة وعمليات الدفع والسحب.
examples.descEn: Implement a stack (LIFO) using a fixed array with push and pop operations.
examples.code:
program stack_array
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: MAX = 10
  integer :: stack(MAX), top, i
  top = 0
  ! دفع عناصر
  call push(10)
  call push(20)
  call push(30)
  ! سحب وطباعة
  do i = 1, 3
    write(*, '(I0)') pop()
  end do
contains
  subroutine push(x)
    integer, intent(in) :: x
    if (top == MAX) then
      write(*, '(A)') 'Stack overflow'
    else
      top = top + 1
      stack(top) = x
    end if
  end subroutine
  integer function pop()
    if (top == 0) then
      pop = -999
    else
      pop = stack(top)
      top = top - 1
    end if
  end function
end program stack_array

examples.descAr: يتعلّم الطالب كيفية تبادل قيمتين باستخدام عمليات الجمع والطرح دون متغيّر مؤقت.
examples.descEn: Learn how to swap two values using addition and subtraction without a temporary variable.
examples.code:
program swap_without_temp
  implicit none
  integer :: a, b
  a = 5
  b = 10
  ! لماذا الجمع والطرح؟ لأن التبادل يتم دون حجز ذاكرة إضافية
  a = a + b
  b = a - b
  a = a - b
  write(*, '(A,I0,A,I0)') 'a=', a, ' b=', b
end program swap_without_temp

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام الدوال العودية لحل لغز أبراج هانوي مع طباعة خطوات النقل.
examples.descEn: Learn to use recursive functions to solve the Tower of Hanoi puzzle and print the moves.
examples.code:
program hanoi
  implicit none
  call move_disk(3, 'A', 'C', 'B')
contains
  recursive subroutine move_disk(n, from, to, aux)
    integer, intent(in) :: n
    character(len=1), intent(in) :: from, to, aux
    if (n == 1) then
      write(*, '(A, A, A, A)') 'Move disk 1 from ', from, ' to ', to
    else
      call move_disk(n-1, from, aux, to)
      write(*, '(A, I0, A, A, A, A)') 'Move disk ', n, ' from ', from, ' to ', to
      call move_disk(n-1, aux, to, from)
    end if
  end subroutine move_disk
end program hanoi
examples.expectedStdout:
Move disk 1 from A to C
Move disk 2 from A to B
Move disk 1 from C to B
Move disk 3 from A to C
Move disk 1 from B to A
Move disk 2 from B to C
Move disk 1 from A to C

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام دالتي adjustl وtrim لإزالة المسافات من بداية النص ونهايته.
examples.descEn: Learn to use adjustl and trim to remove leading and trailing spaces.
examples.code:
program trim_spaces
  implicit none
  character(len=20) :: s = '   hello   '
  character(len=20) :: t
  t = adjustl(s)
  t = trim(t)
  write(*, '(A)') t
end program trim_spaces

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تعريف واستخدام الأنواع الأساسية: integer، real، character، logical مع تنسيق الإخراج.
examples.descEn: Learn to declare and use basic types: integer, real, character, logical with formatted output.
examples.code:
program variables_types
  implicit none
  integer :: age
  real :: height
  character(len=20) :: name
  logical :: is_student

  age = 20
  height = 1.75
  name = "Sara"
  is_student = .true.

  write(*, '(A,I0)') 'Age: ', age
  write(*, '(A,F4.2)') 'Height: ', height
  write(*, '(A,A)') 'Name: ', trim(name)
  write(*, '(A,L1)') 'Student: ', is_student
end program variables_types
examples.expectedStdout:
Age: 20
Height: 1.75
Name: Sara
Student: T
